items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I played all the marches at school, and I played for Sunday school, all the hymns, and my little classical pieces, by Gregg, and, and, and, McDowell

ctx.x: they print that all the time.

So that's the only blues, or jazz I heard, I remember hearing while I was a child. Because, uh, I played all the marches at school, and I played for Sunday school, all the hymns, and my little classical pieces, by Gregg, and, and, and, McDowell, and things like that. And then, uh, when I went to Fisk, I, I was a music special there. And, after graduating from the school in Memphis, they put me in a second grade music, when I went to Fisk.
